page-layout: full

<style>
/* The wrapper already has the real site navbar. Keep the full-screen
   visualization from adding a second page footer below the iframe. */
footer.footer {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>

<div class="column-screen" style="margin: 0;">
<iframe
  id="iran-timeline-frame"
  src="assets/political-text-analysis/trump-iran-connected-timeline.html"
  style="width: 100%; height: calc(100vh - 64px); border: 0; display: block;"
  loading="lazy">
</iframe>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const frame = document.getElementById("iran-timeline-frame");
  if (!frame) return;

  function cleanEmbeddedChrome() {
    try {
      const doc = frame.contentDocument;
      if (!doc) return;

      const innerNav = doc.querySelector(".site-nav");
      if (innerNav) {
        innerNav.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
      }

      if (doc.body) {
        doc.body.classList.remove("has-shared-nav");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      /* Same-origin on the deployed site; fail quietly during local previews. */
    }
  }

  frame.addEventListener("load", cleanEmbeddedChrome);
  cleanEmbeddedChrome();
})();
</script>
